name: @useagent/desktop
description: Thin desktop shell for a hosted UseAgent control plane
author: UseAgent

scripts.build: bun build src/main.ts --target=node --format=cjs --external electron --external electron-updater --outfile=dist/main.cjs && bun build src/preload.ts --target=node --format=cjs --external electron --outfile=dist/preload.cjs
scripts.package:dev: bun run build && USEAGENT_DESKTOP_DEV_PACKAGE=1 CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dir --arm64
scripts.package:mac: bun run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dmg zip --arm64 --x64
scripts.package:win: bun run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:linux: bun run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --linux AppImage deb --x64 --publish never
